identity.name: Gilded Scarab
identity.summary: A gold shelled beetle with a broad dark seam down its back.
identity.description: Supplies 2 ward each round against poison, curse and reflected damage. Each orthogonally touching spell gains +2 damage. Each source applies once per target, regardless of shared edges; distinct sources stack.
identity.lore: The tomb builders hid the real treasury in its shadow.

effects.description: Supplies 2 ward each round against poison, curse and reflected damage. Each orthogonally touching spell gains +2 damage. Each source applies once per target, regardless of shared edges; distinct sources stack.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

empowerment.stacking: once per distinct source and target; different sources add
conditions: Both source and target are equipped.

synergies.description: Orthogonal adjacency support and available mana/stamina determine the best arrangement. Strategic combinations grant no unlisted bonus.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Hedgehog Charm, Tin Beetle, Wax Ear Trumpet into Gilded Scarab.
